notes: GAPS AND CAVEATS. (1) Reload times for torpedoes, sea fire, mortars, rockets and springloaders could not be verified from any source — recorded as null with estimated:true. (2) Base damage for most named/epic seasonal weapons (Faule Ilse, The Warhammer, Endless Requiem, La Piqûre, Divine Thunder, Le Fléau, Crouching Tiger, Phoenix Talons, Heaven's Mandate, Bane of the Ten Suns, White Jade, Agni's Fury, Heavenly Thunder, Virulent Accord, Cloudbinder, Stormtongue, Brightmaw, Reachwarden, Celestial Bloom, Woundcaller, Roaring Meg, Infernal Moss, Nashkar, Vogel Greif) is estimated from same-class equivalents or left null — flagged estimated:true. (3) Year 2 ascension (Basic/Advanced/Mythic tiers, weapon mods) scales damage beyond listed max-craft-tier values and adds rolled mods; listed numbers are pre-ascension max crafted tier. E.g. Thunder Dragon Cannon seen at 2014/2755/3146 base damage across sources depending on ascension and buffs. (4) 'Wicked Wail' (mentioned in task brief) produced zero search hits anywhere — likely does not exist; not included. 'Phoenix Pyre' and 'Ash Breaker' are named in community build guides but no stats found — listed in gaps, Ash Breaker omitted pending confirmation. (5) Vogel Greif appears on the Fandom weapon taxonomy and in tier lists (S-tier demi-cannon) but no stats were published — included with estimated:true. (6) Repair weapons list repair amounts where known; Repair Mortar I-III repair values unverified. (7) Projectile speeds are not published by Ubisoft; all null. (8) Infernal Maw buoy stats (3930 total damage, 65m range, 25s operation, 500 buoy health) and ascension tiers come from gameplay ground truth provided with this task, cross-checked against Y1S2 patch notes (300% eruption damage, Smuggler Pass source). (9) Y3 SUPPLEMENTARY PASS (2026-10-02): added 12 new weapons from Year 3 Season 1 'Shattered Seas' (May 2026) and Year 3 Season 2 'Crimson Waters' (Aug 2026) — Hullcarver, De Breker, L'Aiguille, Blightbearer, Soulsnatcher, Atma's Toll (Y3S1); Scorch Song, Drowning Hellion, Hellfire, Claws of the Deep, Drakon's Jaws, Anathema (Y3S2). Perk text is quoted from the official Ubisoft Y3S1/Y3S2 patch notes. Base damage numbers for all named Y3 weapons are unpublished — damage_per_shot is null and reload/range are inherited from the family class, all marked estimated:true. Hullcarver's Pulverize perk was cross-verified against a community Galleon build guide. Ascended variants (e.g. Siege Dardannelles, Piercing l'Aiguille, Burning Alecto) and Adept-modded weapons are re-ascensions of existing weapons, not new weapons, and are not listed separately. (10) Pre-Y3 gap noticed during this pass: the 'Blightkeeper Springloader' appears in the official Y2S1.1 patch notes but is not in this file — left for a separate pass since it predates Y3.
season_context: Year 3 Season 2 'Crimson Waters' (launched 18 Aug 2026) is the latest released season as of this writing.

status_effect_reference.Ablaze: Triggered by sufficient fire/burning damage. High damage over time.
status_effect_reference.Flooded: Triggered by sufficient flooding damage. Medium DoT (half irreparable via repair kits); slows the ship.
status_effect_reference.Poisoned: Triggered by sufficient toxic damage (Y2S3). ~175-230 base damage/sec vs players (scales with target max HP); -50% brace mitigation; bracing costs 60% more crew stamina.
status_effect_reference.Shell-shocked: Disables the ship's weapons (Y2S1.1: 3.3s duration, up from 5s; +20% buildup threshold on players; diminishing returns enabled). Triggers a one-off 3000 damage AoE.
status_effect_reference.Stormstruck: Triggered by sufficient electric damage. Electric status; synergizes with lightning-strike perks.
status_effect_reference.Taunted: Provoke-family status; increases weakpoint damage taken (50% on Battle Junk). Unlucky Taunt: 250 damage/sec, stacks to 5.
status_effect_reference.Torn Sails: Triggered by sail (tearing) damage. Immobilizes/slows the ship (Y2S1.1: -75% sailing speed).
status_effect_reference.Punctured: Y3S1 status effect. L'Aiguille's Splinter has a 30% chance to instantly Puncture targets in its area of operation; Punctured targets lose 2% Armor Rating per second (up to 14%) within the area. Hullcarver's Pulverize scales to +18% weapon damage against Punctured targets. Ramming with Royal Ramming Works instantly applies 50% Punctured; Needle Shield armor gains Armor Rating and Piercing damage from Bracing hits on Punctured targets.
